notes: Field/option IDs are the OP custom field numbers: managed_by (id 3, option 9) tags a project as Methodos-managed; methodos_sequence (id 4) is the integer priority rank on User Story WPs; discord_thread_id (id 5) is the per-project Discord thread ID, opt-in per project; methodos_epic_number (id 6, Epic type) and methodos_story_number (id 7, User Story type) compose the stable display_id 'eN-sM'. Update IDs if you recreate fields/options in OP admin. Copy this template to ~/.openclaw/workspace/methodos/methodos-projects.json on first use.
